# Provenance

On 2026-07-19, a production deploy served stale artifacts due to insufficient cache-key specificity (Source 2, 14:02–14:07). The deploy-staging job had restored a cache entry keyed only on branch name, failing to account for changes to the lockfile (Source 2, 14:07). Investigation identified the cache step as the root cause, and adding the lockfile hash to the cache key resolved the issue (Source 2, 14:31). The incident consumed approximately 40 minutes of oncall time before resolution (Source 1; Source 2, 14:44). This was the first observed occurrence of this particular failure mode in the deployment pipeline (Source 2, 14:44).
